title: Beyond Prompt-Based Planning: MCP-Native Graph Planning-based Biomedical Agent System
summary: Biomedical agents promise to automate complex biological workflows, yet current systems face two fundamental bottlenecks: bioinformatics tools are highly heterogeneous in interfaces and execution environments, while agent planning still relies on flat prompt-retrieved tool descriptions. As biomedical software ecosystems grow, this coupling between tool coverage and context size leads to tool confusion, unstable planning, and inefficient execution. We introduce BioManus, an MCP-native biomedical agent built on graph-scaffolded planning over structured biological capabilities. BioManus first introduces the BioinfoMCP Compiler, which converts heterogeneous bioinformatics software into standardized MCP servers, yielding a large executable MCP ecosystem. It then organizes this ecosystem as a typed heterogeneous MCP graph over tools, operations, datatypes, and workflow stages. At inference time, BioManus retrieves compact task-specific subgraphs, synthesizes operation-level workflow scaffolds. This design decouples planning complexity from raw tool inventory size, achieving a context compression ratio of Theta(N / (h * m_bar)) under high-recall retrieval, where N is the total tool count, h is the workflow horizon, and m_bar (much smaller than N) is the average number of candidate tools per operation. Experiments on BioAgentBench and LAB-Bench show that BioManus improves execution accuracy, workflow validity, and context efficiency over advanced biomedical agent baselines. This work suggests a paradigm shift: scalable biomedical reasoning requires structured executable capability graphs rather than increasingly larger prompt-level tool retrieval.
tldr: BioManus is an MCP-native biomedical agent that uses graph-scaffolded planning over structured biological capabilities, converting heterogeneous bioinformatics tools into standardized MCP servers and retrieving task-specific subgraphs to decouple planning complexity from tool inventory size, achieving improved execution accuracy and context efficiency.
tldr_zh: BioManus 是一个基于 MCP 原生的生物医学智能体，它通过图结构化的规划来组织生物能力，将异构生物信息学工具转换为标准化的 MCP 服务器，并检索任务特定子图，从而将规划复杂度与工具库存大小解耦，提高了执行准确性和上下文效率。
summary_zh: 生物医学代理有望实现复杂生物工作流的自动化，然而当前系统面临两个根本瓶颈：生物信息学工具在接口和执行环境上高度异构，而智能体的规划仍依赖于基于简单提示检索的扁平化工具描述。随着生物医学软件生态系统的扩展，工具覆盖范围与上下文大小之间的这种耦合会导致工具混淆、规划不稳定和执行效率低下。我们提出 BioManus——一种基于结构化生物能力上的图支撑规划构建的 MCP 原生生物医学代理。BioManus 首先引入 BioinfoMCP 编译器，将异构的生物信息学软件转换为标准化的 MCP 服务器，从而形成一个可执行的大型 MCP 生态系统。随后，它将这一生态系统组织为一种带类型的异构 MCP 图，涵盖工具、操作、数据类型和工作流阶段。在推理时，BioManus 检索紧凑的任务特定子图，并合成操作级的工作流支架。这种设计将规划复杂度与原始工具库存规模解耦，在高召回率检索下实现了上下文压缩比 Θ(N / (h * m̄))，其中 N 是工具总数，h 是工作流步长，m̄（远小于 N）是每个操作的平均候选工具数。在 BioAgentBench 和 LAB-Bench 上的实验表明，相较于先进的生物医学代理基线，BioManus 在执行准确性、工作流有效性和上下文效率方面均有提升。这项工作暗示了一种范式转变：可扩展的生物医学推理需要结构化的可执行能力图，而非越来越大的提示级工具检索。

title: StrokeTimer: Robust Representation Learning for Ischemic Stroke Onset-Time Estimation from Non-contrast CT
summary: Ischemic stroke is a major global disease. Treatment decisions are highly time-sensitive, as eligibility for reperfusion therapies relies on the interval between stroke onset and intervention. However, the true onset time is often uncertain in clinical practice, necessitating imaging-based assessment of tissue age as a surrogate marker. Early ischemic changes on routinely acquired non-contrast CT (NCCT) are often subtle, and real-world clinical datasets exhibit pronounced onset-time class imbalance and center-scanner-related heterogeneity. In this work, we propose StrokeTimer, a fully automated framework for onset-time estimation in acute ischemic stroke. StrokeTimer integrates self-supervised disentanglement learning with energy-guided contrastive learning to capture subtle ischemic patterns while addressing long-tailed data distributions under acquisition variability. Onset time is categorized into three clinically relevant windows: <4.5 h, 4.5-6 h, and >6 h. Experimental results on a large multi-center NCCT dataset from two national cohorts, MR CLEAN Registry and MR CLEAN LATE, show that StrokeTimer achieves a macro AUC of 0.69 and a macro F1-score of 0.57, improving the strongest baseline by nearly 50% (p < 0.005). In this realistic, challenging setting, representative baseline approaches exhibit near-chance macro performance. Model explanations further highlight subtle gray-white matter blurring and hypodense regions consistent with established radiological biomarkers. These findings demonstrate the potential of StrokeTimer to support treatment decision-making in acute ischemic stroke. Code is available at https://github.com/BrainVas/StrokeTimer.
tldr: StrokeTimer is a deep learning framework that estimates ischemic stroke onset time from non-contrast CT by integrating self-supervised disentanglement learning and energy-guided contrastive learning, achieving significant improvements over baselines on multi-center datasets.
tldr_zh: StrokeTimer是一种深度学习框架，通过集成自监督解缠学习和能量引导对比学习，从非增强CT中估计缺血性卒中发病时间，在多中心数据集上取得了显著优于基线的效果。
summary_zh: 缺血性卒中是一种全球性重大疾病。治疗决策具有高度时间敏感性，因为再灌注治疗的可行性取决于卒中发作至干预的时间间隔。然而，在临床实践中，真实发病时间常常不确定，因此需要基于影像的组织年龄评估作为替代标志物。常规非增强CT（NCCT）上的早期缺血性改变往往较细微，而真实世界的临床数据集表现出明显的发病时间类别不平衡以及中心-扫描仪相关的异质性。在本研究中，我们提出StrokeTimer——一个用于急性缺血性卒中发病时间估计的全自动框架。StrokeTimer整合了自监督解耦学习与能量引导对比学习，以捕捉细微的缺血模式，同时应对采集变异性下的长尾数据分布。发病时间被分为三个临床相关窗口：<4.5小时、4.5-6小时和>6小时。在两个国家级队列（MR CLEAN Registry和MR CLEAN LATE）的大型多中心NCCT数据集上的实验结果显示，StrokeTimer实现了0.69的宏观AUC和0.57的宏观F1分数，相比最强基线提升了近50%（p < 0.005）。在这一现实且具有挑战性的场景中，代表性基线方法表现出接近随机水平的宏观性能。模型解释进一步突出了与已确立的放射学生物标志物一致的细微灰白质模糊和低密度区域。这些发现证明了StrokeTimer在支持急性缺血性卒中治疗决策方面的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/BrainVas/StrokeTimer获取。

title: A New Angle on Bones: Robust Pose Estimation in X-Ray and Ultrasound
summary: Measuring the angle between bone structures is a routine task in medical image analysis and provides a key quantitative parameter for diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated methods can reduce time and cost while improving reproducibility. In this work, we address automatic bone pose estimation using a learning-based point candidate proposal followed by a line model to extract axis parameters. Since conventional line models such as least squares are sensitive to outliers, we incorporate false-positive reduction strategies and robust fitting techniques, such as RANSAC and Hough transforms, to improve robustness. We evaluate our method on three clinically relevant paediatric angle estimation tasks: fracture fragment assessment in radiographs and ultrasound and developmental dysplasia of the hip evaluation in ultrasound using the Graf method. Our approach achieves mean errors of $4.1^\circ$, $5.4^\circ$, and $5.51^\circ$, respectively, not only remaining within the expected clinical observer variability, but also significantly outperforming landmark-based methods. Our code and annotations for fracture angle assessment in radiographs are publicly available on GitHub.
tldr: The paper presents a learning-based method for automatic bone pose estimation in X-ray and ultrasound images, using point candidate proposal and robust line fitting (RANSAC, Hough) to measure angles between bone structures, achieving clinically acceptable accuracy on three pediatric tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于学习的自动骨骼姿态估计方法，用于X光和超声图像，通过点候选提议和鲁棒直线拟合（RANSAC、霍夫变换）测量骨骼结构角度，在三个儿科任务上达到了临床可接受的精度。
summary_zh: 测量骨结构之间的角度是医学图像分析中的常规任务，为诊断和治疗规划提供了关键的定量参数。自动化方法可减少时间和成本，同时提高可重复性。本研究提出了一种基于学习的骨姿态自动估计方法，先通过点候选提议，再利用线模型提取轴线参数。由于传统线模型（如最小二乘法）对异常值敏感，我们引入了假阳性抑制策略和鲁棒拟合技术（如RANSAC和霍夫变换）以提升稳健性。我们在三项临床相关的儿科角度估计任务上评估了该方法：X光片和超声中的骨折碎片评估，以及采用Graf法评估超声图像中的发育性髋关节发育不良。我们的方法分别实现了平均误差$4.1^\circ$、$5.4^\circ$和$5.51^\circ$，不仅保持在预期临床观察者变异范围内，而且显著优于基于标志点的方法。我们在GitHub上发布了用于X光片骨折角度评估的代码和标注。

title: XSSR: Cross-Domain Self-Supervised Representative Selection for Efficient Annotation in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Acquiring labeled medical image data is resource-intensive and a challenge further exacerbated in cross-domain scenarios where source and target datasets differ in imaging equipment, population, or clinical site. This study introduces XSSR (Cross-Domain Self-Supervised Representative Selection), a framework designed to minimize annotation effort in the target domain while maintaining robust segmentation performance. XSSR comprises three stages: first, a Masked Autoencoder (MAE) is trained on unlabeled source data to establish a shared embedding space without requiring target labels; second, a greedy selection algorithm scores unlabeled target samples based on a composite density, novelty, and diversity criterion; and third, a U-Net segmentation model is trained exclusively on the selected subset. The novelty-diversity trade-off parameter, alpha, is automatically calibrated by minimizing embedding-space coverage, eliminating manual tuning. We evaluate XSSR on three public benchmarks: Chest X-ray, RIGA+ retinal fundus imaging, and multi-site Prostate MRI, each under a fixed 5% annotation budget. XSSR achieves 99.3% of full-data performance on Chest X-ray using only 22 labeled samples, surpasses random selection by up to 2.5 Dice points on Prostate MRI, and consistently outperforms the CoreSet baseline by 0.4 to 1.2 Dice points across all datasets. Ablation studies indicate that diversity is the most influential scoring component, and per-site analysis shows that performance correlates with scanner similarity to the source domain.
tldr: XSSR is a three-stage framework for cross-domain medical image segmentation that uses a masked autoencoder to learn a shared embedding, a greedy selection algorithm based on density, novelty, and diversity to pick representative samples, and a U-Net trained on the selected subset, achieving high performance under low annotation budgets.
tldr_zh: XSSR是一个三阶段跨域医学图像分割框架，利用掩码自编码器学习共享嵌入，基于密度、新颖性和多样性的贪婪选择算法挑选代表性样本，并在所选子集上训练U-Net，在低标注预算下实现高性能。
summary_zh: 获取带标注的医学图像数据需要大量资源，而在跨域场景（即源数据集与目标数据集在成像设备、人群或临床机构上存在差异）中，这一挑战愈发严峻。本研究提出XSSR（跨域自监督代表性选择）框架，旨在最小化目标域中的标注工作，同时保持稳健的分割性能。XSSR包含三个阶段：首先，在无标注的源数据上训练掩码自编码器（MAE），以建立无需目标标签的共享嵌入空间；其次，基于复合密度、新颖性和多样性准则，通过贪心选择算法对无标注目标样本进行评分；最后，仅在所选子集上训练U-Net分割模型。新颖性-多样性权衡参数alpha通过最小化嵌入空间覆盖率自动校准，无需人工调参。我们在三个公开基准数据集（胸部X光片、RIGA+视网膜眼底影像以及多中心前列腺MRI）上评估XSSR，每个数据集均采用固定的5%标注预算。在仅使用22个标注样本的情况下，XSSR在胸部X光片上达到全数据性能的99.3%；在前列腺MRI上相较于随机选择提升高达2.5个Dice点；在所有数据集上始终优于CoreSet基线0.4至1.2个Dice点。消融研究表明，多样性是影响最大的评分分量，而逐站点分析显示，性能与目标域扫描仪和源域的相似性相关。

title: Enhancing MedSAM with a Lightweight Box Predictor for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation in medical imaging is a critical yet challenging task due to data scarcity and high variability across modalities. While foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) show promise, they often struggle with medical images without specific adaptation. Moreover, point prompts, despite being the most natural form of user interaction, provide insufficient spatial context for reliable segmentation, particularly when target structures are irregular or poorly contrasted. In this paper, we propose an enhanced segmentation framework that integrates a lightweight Box Predictor module into the MedSAM architecture. The Box Predictor estimates an approximate bounding box from a single user click using localized image embedding features, providing spatial guidance that reduces the ambiguity of point prompts, while introducing only 1.6M additional parameters and negligible inference overhead. We introduce a two-stage training pipeline where the Box Predictor is trained independently before being integrated into MedSAM. To validate the generalization capability of our method, we conduct extensive evaluations on four diverse datasets (FLARE22, BRISC, BUSI, LungSegDB) spanning distinct imaging modalities, including CT, MRI, and Ultrasound. Our method improves segmentation accuracy and robustness across varied anatomical structures and imaging domains, achieving Dice scores of 0.89 (BUSI), 0.93 (FLARE22), 0.88 (BRISC), and 0.98 (LungSegDB). Code is available at https://github.com/Amirhosseinmovahedi/MedSAM-BoxPredictor
tldr: Proposes a lightweight Box Predictor module for MedSAM that estimates bounding boxes from a single user click to improve medical image segmentation, achieving Dice scores from 0.88 to 0.98 across four diverse datasets with minimal added parameters.
tldr_zh: 提出一个轻量化的框预测器模块，结合MedSAM，从单次用户点击估计边界框，提升医学图像分割精度，在四个不同数据集上获得0.88至0.98的Dice分数，且参数增加极小。
summary_zh: 摘要：医学图像中的语义分割由于数据稀缺和跨模态的高度变异性，是一项关键且具有挑战性的任务。尽管诸如分割一切模型（SAM）之类的基础模型展现出潜力，但在未经过特定适配的情况下，它们往往难以处理医学图像。此外，尽管点提示是用户最自然的交互形式，但其提供的空间上下文不足，难以实现可靠的分割，尤其是当目标结构不规则或对比度较差时。本文提出了一种增强分割框架，将轻量级边界框预测器模块集成到MedSAM架构中。该边界框预测器利用局部图像嵌入特征，从单次用户点击中估算出近似边界框，从而提供空间引导，减少点提示的模糊性，同时仅引入160万额外参数且推理开销可忽略不计。我们引入了一个两阶段训练流程：先独立训练边界框预测器，再将其集成到MedSAM中。为了验证所提方法的泛化能力，我们在涵盖不同成像模态（包括CT、MRI和超声）的四个多样化数据集（FLARE22、BRISC、BUSI、LungSegDB）上进行了广泛评估。我们的方法在不同解剖结构和成像领域均提升了分割精度与鲁棒性，在BUSI、FLARE22、BRISC和LungSegDB上分别达到了0.89、0.93、0.88和0.98的Dice分数。代码公开于https://github.com/Amirhosseinmovahedi/MedSAM-BoxPredictor。

title: Radiomic Feature Selection Using Gradient Loss of Deep Neural Network for Lung Cancer Stage Detection
summary: Radiomics enables extraction of quantitative imaging biomarkers from medical images and has become an important tool for computer-aided cancer diagnosis. However, radiomics datasets are typically high-dimensional with limited samples, making feature selection a critical step for building reliable predictive models. This study proposes a Gradient-Loss Recursive Feature Elimination (GL-RFE) framework that integrates gradient sensitivity analysis from a deep neural network to identify the most influential radiomic features for lung cancer stage detection. A total of 106 radiomic features were extracted from chest Computed Tomography (CT) scans using the PyRadiomics extension of the 3D Slicer platform. The proposed method evaluates feature importance by computing gradients of the network loss with respect to input features and recursively eliminates features with minimal contribution. The resulting top-15 radiomic features are used to train a deep neural network classifier for distinguishing early-stage and advanced-stage lung cancer. The proposed framework achieves strong classification performance, with accuracy of 90.22%, precision of 90.10%, recall of 90.24%, and F1-score of 90.16% on the test dataset. Visualization analyses, including correlation heat maps and distribution plots, further confirm reduced feature redundancy and improved class separability. Compared to conventional feature selection techniques, GL-RFE effectively captures nonlinear feature interactions and enhances model generalization. The presented protocol provides a reproducible and interpretable methodology for radiomics-based cancer stage detection and is particularly suitable for high-dimensional, small-sample biomedical datasets, with potential applications in other domains such as genomics and multimodal clinical analysis.
tldr: This paper proposes a Gradient-Loss Recursive Feature Elimination (GL-RFE) framework that uses gradient sensitivity from a deep neural network to select radiomic features for lung cancer stage detection, achieving strong classification performance on CT scans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络梯度损失的递归特征消除（GL-RFE）框架，用于选择放射组学特征以检测肺癌分期，在CT扫描上取得了良好的分类性能。
summary_zh: 放射组学能够从医学图像中提取定量成像生物标志物，已成为计算机辅助癌症诊断的重要工具。然而，放射组学数据集通常呈现高维度、小样本的特点，因此特征选择成为构建可靠预测模型的关键步骤。本研究提出一种梯度损失递归特征消除（GL-RFE）框架，该框架整合了深度神经网络的梯度敏感性分析，以识别对肺癌分期检测最具影响力的放射组学特征。利用3D Slicer平台的PyRadiomics扩展，从胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）图像中提取了共106个放射组学特征。所提方法通过计算网络损失相对于输入特征的梯度来评估特征重要性，并递归剔除贡献最小的特征。最终筛选出的前15个放射组学特征用于训练深度神经网络分类器，以区分早期与晚期肺癌。该框架在测试数据集上取得了优异的分类性能：准确率90.22%，精确率90.10%，召回率90.24%，F1分数90.16%。相关性热图与分布图等可视化分析进一步证实了特征冗余的降低和类别可分性的提升。与传统特征选择技术相比，GL-RFE能够有效捕捉非线性特征交互，并增强模型泛化能力。本方案为基于放射组学的癌症分期检测提供了一种可重复且可解释的方法论，尤其适用于高维度、小样本的生物医学数据集，并有望在基因组学、多模态临床分析等其他领域得到应用。

title: CDPM-Align: Multi-Scale Guidance-Aligned Diffusion Pretraining for Robust Few-Shot Anatomical Landmark Detection
summary: Anatomical landmark detection is a fundamental task in medical image analysis supporting a wide range of diagnostic and interventional workflows. Although recent methods have achieved sub-millimetric localisation, accuracy alone is not sufficient for clinical deployment, requiring reliability and robustness in prediction. Despite its clinical relevance, the impact of representation learning in this context is still underexplored. In this work, we introduce CDPM-align, a multi-scale guidance-aligned conditional diffusion pre-training for anatomical landmark detection. Our experimental setup focuses on a few images and a few annotation regimes. Specifically, we employ three popular heterogeneous small-scale benchmark datasets for representation learning via conditional generative pre-training. Furthermore, we consider low-annotation scenarios for the downstream task of landmark detection, with 10 and 25 annotated images, reflecting realistic trade-offs between clinical effort and resource constraints for annotations. Our results confirm that generative pre-training enables the model to learn a robust representation. This improves both accuracy and uncertainty on the downstream tasks, advancing towards safe and efficient clinical deployment.
tldr: The paper proposes CDPM-Align, a multi-scale guidance-aligned conditional diffusion pretraining method for few-shot anatomical landmark detection, achieving improved accuracy and uncertainty with limited annotations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CDPM-Align，一种多尺度引导对齐的条件扩散预训练方法，用于少样本解剖标志点检测，在有限标注下提高了准确性和不确定性。
summary_zh: 解剖标志点检测是医学图像分析中的一项基础任务，支持广泛的诊断和介入工作流程。尽管近期方法已实现亚毫米级定位，但仅凭准确性不足以支持临床部署，还需要预测的可靠性和鲁棒性。尽管具有临床相关性，但表征学习在此背景下的影响仍未被充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出CDPM-align，一种用于解剖标志点检测的多尺度引导对齐条件扩散预训练方法。我们的实验设置聚焦于少量图像和少量标注场景。具体而言，我们采用三个流行的异构小规模基准数据集，通过条件生成预训练进行表征学习。此外，我们考虑了下游标志点检测任务的低标注场景，分别使用10张和25张标注图像，反映了临床工作与标注资源约束之间的现实权衡。我们的结果证实，生成式预训练使模型能够学习到鲁棒的表示。这提高了下游任务的准确性和不确定性，朝着安全高效的临床部署迈进。

title: Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction via Latent-Space Motion Tracking from Single Measurement
summary: Prospective reconstruction is crucial in many clinical applications such as MRI-guided radiotherapy, which demands accurate image reconstruction and fast motion estimation from currently acquired measurements. However, prospective reconstruction remains challenging due to ultra-sparse sampling and stringent latency requirements. In this work, we propose PDMR, a Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction framework with latent-space motion tracking. Our core idea is to learn an efficient and generalizable latent manifold of motion fields offline, enabling rapid online adaptation for prospective reconstruction. Specifically, we parameterize the deformation vector fields (DVFs) on a low-dimensional manifold, effectively reducing the search space for fast online adaptation, and employ a tri-plane representation to achieve geometry-aware and memory-efficient encoding of 3D motion. Experiments on both XCAT digital phantoms and in-house abdominal MRI datasets demonstrate that PDMR achieves high-fidelity and temporally consistent reconstruction across multiple prospective scenarios (Immediate and After-2min), outperforming state-of-the-art retrospective and online methods. Our results suggest a promising pathway toward ultra-fast, motion-aware prospective MRI reconstruction in clinical practice.
tldr: A prospective dynamic 3D MRI reconstruction method using latent-space motion tracking to enable fast online adaptation from single measurements, achieving high-fidelity temporally consistent results for applications like MRI-guided radiotherapy.
tldr_zh: 一种利用潜在空间运动跟踪实现单次测量快速在线适应的前瞻性动态3D MRI重建方法，在MRI引导放疗等应用中获得了高保真、时间一致的成像结果。
summary_zh: 前瞻性重建在诸如MRI引导放射治疗等许多临床应用中至关重要，这些应用需要从当前采集的测量值中实现精确的图像重建和快速的运动估计。然而，由于超稀疏采样和严格的延迟要求，前瞻性重建仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们提出了PDMR——一种具有潜在空间运动跟踪的前瞻性动态3D MRI重建框架。我们的核心思想是离线学习一个高效且可泛化的运动场潜在流形，从而实现快速在线自适应前瞻性重建。具体而言，我们将变形矢量场（DVFs）参数化到低维流形上，有效缩小了快速在线自适应的搜索空间，并采用三平面表示来实现几何感知且内存高效的3D运动编码。在XCAT数字体模和内部腹部MRI数据集上的实验表明，PDMR在多种前瞻性场景（即刻和2分钟后）下实现了高保真且时间一致的重建，性能优于最先进的回顾性和在线方法。我们的研究结果为临床实践中实现超快速、运动感知的前瞻性MRI重建提供了一条有前景的途径。

title: Provably Auditable and Safe LLM Agents from Human-Authored Ontologies
summary: We introduce the LLM agent architecture Agentic Redux, intended for use with nontrivial problem domains that require linear auditability. Using the typed lambda calculus, we prove that, run on appropriate domains, Agentic Redux executions are semantically guaranteed to be correct, with all decisions recorded in an append-only ledger. We present two production-grade appropriate domains, in healthcare billing compliance, and security vulnerability disclosure. Working code for Agentic Redux run on both domains is available in a supporting code repository. We also introduce Ontology-First Agent Design, a methodology for creation of agent frameworks on a problem domain, in which a human expert ontologizes the problem domain with Basic Formal Ontology, and then assigns an LLM to derive roles that agents and humans-in-the-loop can fill, in order to work the problems in the domain.
tldr: This paper introduces Agentic Redux, an LLM agent architecture with provable correctness and auditability using typed lambda calculus, along with the Ontology-First Agent Design methodology. It demonstrates applications in healthcare billing compliance and security vulnerability disclosure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Agentic Redux的LLM智能体架构，利用类型化λ演算实现可证明的正确性和可审计性，并介绍了本体优先智能体设计方法。在医疗计费合规和安全漏洞披露领域展示了应用。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
我们提出了LLM代理架构Agentic Redux，旨在用于需要线性可审计性的复杂问题领域。利用类型化λ演算，我们证明了在适当领域运行时，Agentic Redux的执行在语义上保证正确，且所有决策均记录在仅追加账本中。我们展示了两个生产级适用领域：医疗账单合规与安全漏洞披露。支持代码仓库中提供了在两个领域上运行Agentic Redux的工作代码。此外，我们还引入了本体优先的代理设计——一种在问题领域上创建代理框架的方法论，其中人类专家使用基本形式本体对问题领域进行本体化，随后指派LLM推导出代理和人机环参与者可承担的角色，以处理该领域中的问题。
